description: High-resolution Spot 5 satellite imagery captured on 2012-08-27, showing a landscape composed of agricultural fields and semi-natural dry grasslands at the Himsklamm Natura 2000 (N2K) site in Germany. The image is rendered as a false-colour composite using a 1/2/3 band combination, providing a spatial resolution of 2.5 metres. The image prominently features an irregularly shaped area delineated by a bright green outline, encompassing diverse land cover. Inside and outside this boundary, cultivated agricultural plots are visible in various shades of green, while larger expanses of reddish-brown land indicate drier vegetation or bare ground, characteristic of calcareous dry grasslands. A single bright green circular marker is positioned within the reddish-brown area, slightly to the right of the image centre. The data is sourced from CNES 2012©, distributed by Airbus DS/Spot Image.
